inhaleStudy.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent upper-body animation layer for an existing plush-toy mobile game. Input 1 is the exact character identity and material reference (blue koala in a blue fabric flower pot), input 2 shows its current leaning pose. Produce ONE isolated UPPER BODY, head, ears, chest, shoulders and TWO arms/paws of the SAME blue koala, in the specified new animation pose. Keep its big fluffy blue ears with cream inner ears, blue fur, cream muzzle and belly, dark oval nose, large glossy brown eyes, miniature soft stuffed-animal anatomy, and soft upper-right studio light. The toy looks adorably fierce and earnest, never frightened. Do not render the pot, leaves, feet or lower body: this transparent layer will be drawn over the EXACT existing pot in the game. The two cream paws are braced on an invisible pot rim: centers at 25% and 75% of image width, near 84% image height, paw bottoms aligned at 91% image height. Arms connect visibly to shoulders with a gap beside the cream chest so the bracing silhouette reads at a 55-pixel display size. Square canvas, centered single character, whole head/ears/paws visible, 5% transparent margin on all sides. No text, shadow on ground, bubbles, speed lines, props, watermarks, sheet or multiple panels. Genuine transparent background. Preserve plush fibers, not smooth plastic.
POSE: INHALE / WIND UP. Both paws grip the invisible rim wide apart. The torso stretches upright, chest clearly visible between the arms; head pulled BACK and UP, smaller in perspective than the reference leaning pose, chin slightly raised, closed lips and visibly round inflated cheeks. Shoulder line raised, elbows bent. Brow lowered in cute concentration, eyes looking toward the viewer and slightly upward. Head and ears form a tall slightly narrow silhouette; this must clearly contrast with the later forward/downward blowing pose. Keep hands at their fixed rim anchors. Body ends between the hands, no long dangling torso.

strips.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production three-frame sprite animation strip for a plush toy mobile game. Make ONE wide 3:1 transparent sprite strip with exactly THREE equally sized SQUARE cells in ONE horizontal row. Input image is the exact character identity, colors, face, ears, plush material and lighting reference. Each cell contains ONLY the same animal's UPPER BODY: head, ears, chest, shoulders, two arms/paws (wings for birds), NO pot, NO leaves, NO feet or lower body. These three layers will animate above the game's original unchanged pot.
Left cell INHALE: head pulled backward and upward, chin slightly raised, puffed cheeks, closed lips, clearly visible chest, both paws braced wide at invisible rim. Middle cell BLOW: chest leans forward, head lunges forward and downward, more top of head visible, strong puckered O mouth (open beak for birds, rounded trunk opening for elephant), cheeks forcefully blowing, shoulders spread, paws firmly grip rim. Right cell REBOUND: head rocks slightly backward with chin up, shoulders relax down, ears follow with a soft lag, lips relaxed, paws still on rim. The THREE silhouettes must be clearly DIFFERENT, with head position changing by about 12% of cell height, NOT merely swapping mouths. Cute fierce effort, not frightened, angry or aggressive.
Keep paw contact anchors and torso root CONSISTENT in all cells: left and right paws centered at 26% and 74% of each cell width, bottom of paws at 90% cell height. Whole head/ears/paws fit inside each cell, 6% clear transparent side margin. Chest ends between paws, just above their bottom line, no dangling body or legs. Same character scale across the strip, no changes to species/color. Dense fine plush fibers, cream muzzle/underside where present in reference, glossy expressive toy eyes, soft studio light matching reference, clean alpha edges. No text, labels, separators, grid, bubbles, effects, background, ground shadow, watermark, pot or leaves. Transparent background with real alpha. Center the character horizontally in each cell.
CHARACTER: koala (考拉), color #42A9FF. Match the exact referenced character, including its distinctive face and head features.
